app.name: E2B
app.description: Cloud sandboxes ('agent computers') that let AI agents run code and use their own cloud computers.

observations.note: Business Wire release dated Nov 5, 2026. Search summaries of the release body say E2B 'has passed $100 million in annualized run rate', its 'first public revenue disclosure', coming 'almost 100% from ALG: Agentic-Led Growth'; the syndicated headline says 'Passes $120 Million in Annualized Run Rate' (some copies: 'Annual Recurring Revenue'). The sources conflict on 100M vs 120M; recorded the lower stated threshold ($100M passed is true under either reading) - reviewer should check the release. A threshold. No period end date given, so dated to the Nov 5 announcement. Revenue type not stated, so no basis. Also stated: 'at $8m just a year ago' (two levels; no growth rate derived). Company-reported, unaudited. Search-result snippets/summaries only; the page was not read (WebFetch stopped after ENOTFOUND on two hosts). Same release: https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/e2b-gives-ai-agents-own-150000787.html

app.name: Figma MCP server
app.description: Figma's Model Context Protocol server that gives AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, etc.) access to Figma design context and write-back.

observations.note: Figma Q3 2026 earnings call (Nov 4, 2026; transcript posted Nov 5): the MCP server has 'approximately 1 million weekly active users' and is 'our fastest-growing product by growth in weekly active users'. Approximate figure. The call gives no as-of date for the count, so dated to the Nov 4 call. Basis wau as stated. Also stated: 'total MCP usage grew 3x quarter-over-quarter' and write-back usage 4x QoQ (usage, not users; not recorded). Company-reported. Search-result snippets/summaries only; the transcript was not read.

app.name: Cars.com Carson
app.description: Cars.com's multilingual AI shopping assistant that turns conversational car-shopping requests into search results.

observations.note: Cars.com Q3 2026 results (Nov 5, 2026): Carson 'crossed 1 million monthly users, nearly doubling year-over-year'; earnings call (https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/11/05/carscom-cars-q3-2026-earnings-call-transcript/): Carson 'almost doubled its user base year-over-year to surpass 1 million monthly users during Q3'. A threshold. 'Monthly users' read as basis mau. The figure is for 'during Q3' with no as-of date stated, so dated to the Nov 5 announcement. 'Nearly/almost doubled' is not a precise rate, so no growth_pct. App URL is Cars.com's Carson launch release (no dedicated Carson page found). Search-result snippets only; neither page was read.
